title: Light Zurich-style sliced chicken with rice
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Cut the chicken into thin strips, slice the mushrooms and chop the shallots.
Sear the chicken in batches in the hot oil for 2–3 minutes, season and set aside.
Fry the shallots and mushrooms in the same pan for 5 minutes, add the stock and cream, thicken with the cornflour mixed with a little water and simmer for 2 minutes.
Return the chicken, just heat through, season with lemon juice, salt and pepper and serve with parsley and rice.
